text.body: ॥ aṣṭamūrtyaṣṭakam ॥ tuṣṭāvāṣṭatanuṃ hṛṣṭaḥ praphullanayanāñcalaḥ। maulāvañjalimādhāya vadan jayajayetica ॥ 1 bhārgava uvācaḥ tvaṃ bhābhirābhirabhibhūya tamassamastamastaṃ nyasyamimataṃ ca niśācarāṇām । dedīpyase dinamaṇe gagane hitāya lokatrayasya jagadīśvara tannamaste ।। 2 loketivelamativela mahāmahobhirnirmāsi kaumudamudaṃ ca samutsamudram । vidrāvitākhilatamāssutamohimāṃśo pīyūṣapūraparipūrita tannamaste ॥ 3 tvaṃ pāvane pathi sadāgatirapyupāsyaḥ kastvāṃ vinā bhuvanajīvana jīvatīha । stabdhaprabhañjana vivardhitasarvajanto santoṣitāhikula sarvaga tannamaste ॥ 4 viśvaikapāvaka natāvaka pāvakaika śakteṛte mṛtabatāmṛtadivyakāryam । prāṇityado jagadaho jagadantarātman tatpāvaka pratipadaṃ śamadaṃ namaste॥ 5 pānīyarūpa parameśa jagatpavitra citraṃ vicitra sucaritra karoṣi nūnam । viśvaṃ pavitramamalaṃ kila viśvanātha pānāvagāhanata etadato nato'smi ॥ 6 ākāśarūpa bahirantaritāvakāśa dānādvikasvara maheśvara viśvametat । tvattassadā sadaya saṃśvasiti svabhāvātsaṃkocameti bhavatosmi natastatastvām ॥ 7 viśvambharātmaka bibharti vibhotra viśvaṃ koviśvanātha bhavatonyatamastamore । tattvāṃ vinā naśamināhi phaṇāhibhūṣa stavyo paraḥ paratara praṇatastatastvām ॥ 8 ātmasvarūpa tava rūpaparamparābhirābhistataṃ hara carācararūpametat । sarvāntarātmanilaya pratirūparūpanityaṃ nato'smi paramātmatano'ṣṭamūrte ॥ 9 ityaṣṭamūrtibhirimābhirumābhinandha vanyātivandha tava viśvajanītamūrte। etattataṃ nu vitataṃ praṇatapraṇīta sarvārthasārthaparamārthatano nato'smi ॥ 10 aṣṭamūrtyaṣṭakeneṣṭaṃ pariṣṭutyeti bhārgavaḥ । bhargaṃ bhūmimilanmauliḥ praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ ॥11 ॥ iti śrīśukrācāryakṛtaṃ aṣṭamūrtyaṣṭakam ॥
